name: Campus Pickup Window
idea: Post a seven-day pickup window offer and ask customers to reserve a coffee through the cafe's existing ordering channel.
sample_caption: Short break between classes? Reserve your coffee for pickup today.
differentiation_reason: Pickup is a modest point of difference.
feasibility_reason: Uses an existing channel and limited promotion.

name: Pastry Pairing Reel
idea: Film three short clips showing affordable coffee and pastry pairings with a clear visit invitation.
sample_caption: Pick your study break pairing and visit us this week.
kpi: In-store redemptions of a named pairing
differentiation_reason: Content can highlight the cafe's own menu.

name: Study Break Story Poll
idea: Run story polls on preferred coffee break times, then publish one timetable post based on responses.
sample_caption: When is your coffee break? Vote in our story and stop by this week.
assumptions: Cafe has an active Instagram account
differentiation_reason: Polls are common but can inform timing.
